scope: Ten individually checked false memberships, with positive controls. No conclusion about the other members of this large family.

rejected_memberships.reason: Latin abstractus < abstrahere < trahere, not actus.
Latin intactus contains tactus from tangere 'touch', not actus 'act'.
The practical stem ultimately follows Greek praktikos, not Latin actus.
Kontakt follows Latin contactus/contingere and tangere, not actus.
Charakter follows Greek charaktēr through Latin character, not actus.
Contact is from Latin contactus, from tangere through contingere, not actus.
Caractère follows Greek charaktēr through Latin character, not actus.
Contacto follows Latin contactus from contingere/tangere, not actus.
Contatto follows Latin contactus from contingere/tangere, not actus.
Carattere follows Greek charaktēr through Latin character, not actus.

review_scope: The source label manually_verified on a compound_morphology record does not mean this membership was independently checked; all ten rejected records carried that label. The remaining family still has many unreviewed links and may contain other false positives.
